quarto preview
To deploy to github run
quarto publish gh-pages
Sometimes, there is stale cached output:
quarto render --cache-refresh
rm -rf _freeze/ .quarto/
Then try,
rm -rf _site/
quarto render

quarto render

Oliver Hannaoui



I am a second-year Statistics PhD student at Carnegie Mellon University. I am also a member of Delphi, where I am working on leveraging time-series foundation models for infectious disease forecasting.
Previously, I completed an M1 in Applied Mathematics and Statistics at the Polytechnic Institute of Paris. Prior to that, I spent two formative years at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York as a Senior Research Analyst in the Financial Intermediation group.
